stops.note: to give up over, from super- (over) and reddere (to give back)
carried into French for giving oneself up or handing something over
stops.meaning: to give oneself up, to hand over

stops.note: settled as the English word for giving up control or ceasing resistance
stops.meaning: to give up control or cease resistance

current_meaning: to give up control, possession, or resistance, especially to an opponent
